# Ra.One Summary
"Ra.One" centers on a new technology developed by Barron Industries in London that allows digital world elements to enter the real world via wireless transmissions. A video game, created by Shekhar Subramaniam for his son Prateek, features a protagonist, G.One, and a faceless, more powerful antagonist, Ra.One, who is imbued with a self-learning AI. The game's malfunction allows Ra.One to break free and enter reality.
Ra.One murders Shekhar Subramaniam after he falsely claims to be the protagonist, G.One, in an attempt to save Prateek. G.One eventually enters the real world and temporarily disables Ra.One with a gas explosion, taking Ra.One's H.A.R.T. In a later confrontation, G.One defeats the ten copies Ra.One creates by targeting the one with a shadow. After absorbing Ra.One's remains, G.One returns to the digital world, and months later, Prateek restores G.One to reality.
